title: What is an NFT?
description: NFT stands for 'non-fungible token. An NFT is basically data that is accounted for in a digital ledger, and that data represents something specific and unique. An NFT can, for example, represent a unique piece of art or a game token

title: What is a Knights Game NFT?
description: Knights game is a Play to Earn NFT game with a new way of playing, giving players $GODL and NFT while playing the game. We designed gameplay that can trigger your talent in strategic thinking and teamwork. Knights can be staked to earn $GODL, which is used to get other NFT items as well as level up. We are continuously developing this game so that you can really enjoy and earn more from this amazing GameFi.

title: How can I buy a Knights Game NFT?
description: You will be able to buy on our website when we launch. Join our discord to have more information about our launch date. Please install Metamask to purchase the NFT.

title: What does MINT mean?
description: NFT Minting is the process by which your digital art or digital content becomes a part of the Ethereum blockchain.

title: How much does it cost to buy one Knights Game NFT?
description: The mint price has not been disclosed yet. We will announce it on Discord at the same time as the announcement of the mint date.

title: How many NFTs will be available?
description: Knights Game is a collection of 10,000 NFTs.

title: How can I get access to the whitelist?
description: You can get access to the whitelist by participating in giveaways on our social media (Instagram, Twitter), or to win contest, games on Discord
